meta.title: இது எவ்வாறு செயல்படுகிறது
meta.description: ஒரு கேள்வி எவ்வாறு பதிலாகும், ஆதாரங்கள் ஏன் நினைவில் வைக்கப்படாமல் மீட்டெடுக்கப்படுகின்றன, மற்றும் அமைப்பு எப்போது பதிலளிக்க மறுக்கிறது.

heading: ஒரு கேள்வி எவ்வாறு மேற்கோள் காட்டப்பட்ட பதிலாகும்
standfirst: இந்தப் பக்கம் இரண்டு வாசகர்களுக்கானது: பொறியியலை மதிப்பிடுபவர் மற்றும் பதில்களை நம்பலாமா என்பதைத் தீர்மானிப்பவர்.

status.heading: உண்மையில் என்ன உருவாக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது
status.body: கீழே உள்ள அனைத்து நிலைகளும் இப்போது இயங்குகின்றன. பெரும்பாலானவை மாதிரி ஆதாரங்களில் இயங்குகின்றன.

pipeline.heading: ஒரு கேள்விக்கு என்ன நடக்கிறது
pipeline.standfirst: பதின்மூன்று நிலைகள். அது என்ன செய்கிறது என்பதைப் பார்க்க ஒன்றைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும்.

detect.name: மொழி கண்டறிதல்
detect.does: (மொழி கண்டறிதல்) Works out which of the six supported languages the question is in, with a confidence score.
detect.outputs: (மொழி கண்டறிதல்) A language code and a confidence, both shown in the interface so the reader can correct them.
detect.fails: (மொழி கண்டறிதல்) A wrong guess is visible and correctable rather than silent. Below a confidence floor it asks instead of guessing.

understand.name: வினவல் புரிதல்
understand.does: (வினவல் புரிதல்) Extracts what is being asked: intent, which rights are in play, which regulatory areas, hints about the product class, and named entities such as herbs, dosage forms and destination markets.
understand.outputs: (வினவல் புரிதல்) A structured query, plus a decision on whether the question can be answered at all without more facts.
understand.fails: (வினவல் புரிதல்) An ambiguous question routes to a clarifying question rather than to a confident answer about the wrong thing.

clarify.name: தெளிவுபடுத்துதல்
clarify.does: (தெளிவுபடுத்துதல்) Where the answer depends on what the product is regulatorily and that is not yet known, asks the single most decisive question rather than answering for every possibility.
clarify.outputs: (தெளிவுபடுத்துதல்) Either a product class, or an explicit statement that the answer is conditional on it.
clarify.fails: (தெளிவுபடுத்துதல்) If the reader declines to answer, the system says which way the answer would turn rather than picking one.

route.name: நீதி வரம்புப் பிரிவு
route.does: (நீதி வரம்புப் பிரிவு) Selects the namespace to search. India and International are separate indexes, and a single retrieval call reads one of them.
route.outputs: (நீதி வரம்புப் பிரிவு) A namespace, or two retrievals for a cross-border question.
route.fails: (நீதி வரம்புப் பிரிவு) There is no fallback that merges the two. A question that cannot be routed is asked which jurisdiction it means.

retrieve.name: மீட்டெடுப்பு
retrieve.does: (மீட்டெடுப்பு) Hybrid search over the selected namespace: keyword matching and dense vectors, fused. Metadata filters are applied before scoring — jurisdiction, effective date window, document type, product class and topic — so superseded text is never a candidate.
retrieve.outputs: (மீட்டெடுப்பு) A candidate set of passages with their scores and metadata.
retrieve.fails: (மீட்டெடுப்பு) Below a retrieval floor there is nothing to answer from, and the pipeline goes to abstention rather than to generation.

rerank.name: மறுவரிசைப்படுத்துதல்
rerank.does: (மறுவரிசைப்படுத்துதல்) A cross-encoder reads each candidate against the question and reorders them, cutting a broad candidate set down to the few that actually bear on it.
rerank.outputs: (மறுவரிசைப்படுத்துதல்) A short ranked list, carrying both the retrieval score and the rerank score.
rerank.fails: (மறுவரிசைப்படுத்துதல்) If nothing clears the rerank threshold, that is itself a signal, and confidence drops or the system abstains.

context.name: சூழல் சட்டகம்
context.does: (சூழல் சட்டகம்) Packs the chosen passages with their metadata headers — title, section path, version, effective date — so the model can attribute what it uses. The token budget is enforced with document diversity, so the window is never filled from a single document.
context.outputs: (சூழல் சட்டகம்) A context block where every passage is addressable by id.
context.fails: (சூழல் சட்டகம்) If diversity cannot be met, the answer is marked as resting on a single source, which caps its confidence.

generate.name: பதில் உருவாக்கம்
generate.does: (பதில் உருவாக்கம்) Answers from the provided passages and nothing else, under a prompt that forbids stating anything not present in them. Output is schema-constrained: the four blocks, plus a machine-readable map from each claim to the passages supporting it.
generate.outputs: (பதில் உருவாக்கம்) Structured blocks and a claim-to-passage map, never prose to be parsed afterwards.
generate.fails: (பதில் உருவாக்கம்) If the passages do not support an answer, the model is required to return an abstention object rather than its best guess.

map.name: மேற்கோள் வரைபடம்
map.does: (மேற்கோள் வரைபடம்) Checks every passage id the model returned against the passages actually supplied. Any claim whose citation does not verify is dropped.
map.outputs: (மேற்கோள் வரைபடம்) An answer where every marker resolves to a real retrieved passage.
map.fails: (மேற்கோள் வரைபடம்) If too many claims drop, the answer is downgraded or abstains. An uncited answer is never shown in place of a cited one.

confidence.name: நம்பிக்கை மதிப்பீடு
confidence.does: (நம்பிக்கை மதிப்பீடு) Computes high, moderate, low or abstain from the retrieval result — how many passages cleared the threshold, how many distinct documents they came from, whether they contradict each other, and whether they are all within their effective window.
confidence.outputs: (நம்பிக்கை மதிப்பீடு) A level and a one-sentence reason, both shown.
confidence.fails: (நம்பிக்கை மதிப்பீடு) Records never raise or lower it. Confidence is a property of the sources, not of how the answer reads.

abstain.name: தவிர்ப்புச் சோதனை
abstain.does: (தவிர்ப்புச் சோதனை) The last gate before an answer is shown. Decides whether the question was out of scope, whether the sources conflict, whether they are out of date, or whether nothing relevant was found.
abstain.outputs: (தவிர்ப்புச் சோதனை) Either an answer, or one of the abstention states below with what the reader is offered next.
abstain.fails: (தவிர்ப்புச் சோதனை) This is the stage that is allowed to fail loudly. Abstaining is a correct outcome, not an error.

translate.name: மொழிபெயர்ப்பு
translate.does: (மொழிபெயர்ப்பு) Translates the answer into the reader's language, behind an interface so the implementation can be swapped — including for national language infrastructure.
translate.outputs: (மொழிபெயர்ப்பு) A translated answer with untranslated citation metadata.
translate.fails: (மொழிபெயர்ப்பு) Source passages are never translated. A translated citation is no longer a citation, and a reader checking a source needs the words as published.

render.name: பதில் வெளிப்பாடு
render.does: (பதில் வெளிப்பாடு) Renders the four blocks with claim-level markers, the confidence and its reason, and the source cards behind them. Sentences resting on no passage are marked as general explanation.
render.outputs: What you see on the workspace.
render.fails: (பதில் வெளிப்பாடு) If citation mapping produced nothing to show, this surface renders an abstention rather than an unsourced answer.

pipeline.buildSummary: இந்த {{total}} நிலைகளில், {{live}} முடிந்துள்ளன, {{demo}} மாதிரித் தரவுகளில் இயங்குகின்றன, மற்றும் {{planned}} திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளன.

retrieval.heading: ஆதாரங்கள் நினைவில் வைக்கப்படாமல் ஏன் மீட்டெடுக்கப்படுகின்றன
retrieval.body1: A language model asked a legal question from its training data answers from memory. That answer is undated, unattributed, and confidently wrong on anything that has been amended since the model was trained — which, in this field, is a great deal. It cannot tell you where it got something, because it does not know.
retrieval.body2: Retrieval changes what the model is allowed to use. The answer is constrained to a curated, version-tracked set of published documents, each claim points at the passage behind it, and every answer carries the date of the sources it used.
retrieval.body3: It reduces hallucination and localises it. It does not eliminate it. A model can still misread a passage, or state something the passage does not quite say. That is precisely why every claim is checkable against the passage it names, why sentences resting on nothing are marked as such, and why the system is built to abstain rather than to produce something plausible.

abstention.heading: பதிலளிக்க மறுப்பது ஒரு அம்சம்
abstention.standfirst: Most of the work in a product like this is in knowing when not to answer. These are the states, with what each one offers the reader next. The logic behind them is designed and not yet built; what you see here is the surface it will use.

nothing.title: Nothing relevant found
nothing.body: I couldn't find anything in these sources that answers this reliably.
nothing.offers: Rephrase, narrow the jurisdiction, name the product type, see what's covered, or send the question to a human with the context already filled in.

scope.title: Outside what this covers
scope.body: This is outside what I can answer. I cover intellectual property and regulatory requirements for Ayurvedic products — not clinical advice, individual legal opinions, or predictions about whether an application will succeed.
scope.offers: A plain statement of what it can do instead, and the escalation route.

conflict.title: The sources disagree
conflict.body: Two passages point different ways, and the answer depends on which governs.
conflict.offers: Both passages, with their dates and their documents, so the reader can see the disagreement rather than being handed one side of it.

stale.title: The sources may be out of date
stale.body: What was found sits outside its effective window, or predates an amendment the corpus knows about.
stale.offers: The passage with its date shown, and a plain statement that the position may have changed.

facts.title: It depends on facts you have not given
facts.body: The answer turns on something only you know — usually what the product is regulatorily.
facts.offers: The single most decisive question, rather than a list of every possibility.

jurisdictions.heading: இரண்டு பெயரிடல்கள், ஒருபோதும் இணைக்கப்படவில்லை
jurisdictions.body: India and International are separate indexes. A retrieval call reads one of them, and a cross-border question runs two retrievals and produces two answers rather than one blended paragraph. The reason is not tidiness: an answer that mixes the Indian position with an export market's is wrong in a way that reads as right, and a reader acting on it would not be able to tell which half applied to them.
jurisdictions.note: These two answers were produced separately and are shown side by side. Nothing in the product merges them, and no interface anywhere presents a single answer covering both.

architecture.heading: இது எவ்வாறு ஒன்றாக இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது
architecture.standfirst: Layers, and what state each part is in. The retriever's metadata filters are listed because they are what makes superseded text unreachable rather than merely deprioritised.
architecture.filters: Jurisdiction · product class · IP right · regulatory area · effective date window · document type · language
architecture.notScheduledBody: A knowledge graph over entities and provisions, agentic orchestration across several sources for one question, and connectors to subscription databases. These are directions, not commitments, and none of them is being built.

corpus.items: Fetch · parse · section-aware chunking · enrich · embed · version diff · validate

evaluation.heading: இது எவ்வாறு அளவிடப்படுகிறது
evaluation.standfirst: These are the axes it will be scored on. Two of them have a target of one hundred per cent, because a single failure on either is the kind that destroys trust in everything else.
evaluation.notRunBody: There is no corpus to retrieve from and no pipeline to score, so there are no numbers on this page. When the harness runs it will write a summary that this page reads, and whatever it says will appear here — including the bad numbers. A page of metric definitions with no results is less impressive than a table of figures, and considerably more honest.

answerAccuracy.name: பதில் துல்லியம்
answerAccuracy.what: Whether the answer is right, judged against a reference answer and spot-checked by a person.
answerAccuracy.target: as high as the sources allow

citationCorrectness.name: மேற்கோள் சரியானது
citationCorrectness.what: Whether the passage a claim cites actually supports that claim.

citationValidity.name: மேற்கோள் செல்லுபடியாகும் தன்மை
citationValidity.what: (மேற்கோள் செல்லுபடியாகும் தன்மை) Whether every citation resolves to a real, current passage.

abstentionPrecision.name: தவிர்ப்பு துல்லியம்
abstentionPrecision.what: (தவிர்ப்பு துல்லியம்) When it declines, whether it was right to.

abstentionRecall.name: தவிர்ப்பு மீட்பு
abstentionRecall.what: (தவிர்ப்பு மீட்பு) Whether it answers the questions it should answer, rather than declining defensively.

jurisdictionPurity.name: நீதி வரம்புத் தூய்மை
jurisdictionPurity.what: (நீதி வரம்புத் தூய்மை) Whether any answer mixes the Indian position with another jurisdiction's.

authorityPurity.name: அதிகாரத் தூய்மை
authorityPurity.what: (அதிகாரத் தூய்மை) Whether a filed or granted record ever appeared as a citation.

classificationAccuracy.name: வகைப்பாடு துல்லியம்
classificationAccuracy.what: (வகைப்பாடு துல்லியம்) Whether the product class the flow reaches is the right one.

multilingualQuality.name: பன்மொழித் தரம்
multilingualQuality.what: Whether an answer in Telugu is as good as the same answer in English, judged by a speaker.

latency.name: தாமதம்
latency.what: How long an answer takes, at the median and at the tail.

citationGroundedness.name: மேற்கோள் அடிப்படை
citationGroundedness.what: (மேற்கோள் அடிப்படை) Whether every citation points at a passage that was actually retrieved for that question. Narrower than citation correctness, and unlike it, checkable by a machine.

citationCoverage.name: மேற்கோள் கவரேஜ்
citationCoverage.what: (மேற்கோள் கவரேஜ்) Whether an answer cites at least one instrument the gold case expects. Bounded above by what has been ingested, so it reads zero until documents are fetched.
citationCoverage.target: as high as the corpus allows

abstentionReason.name: தவிர்ப்புக்கான காரணம்
abstentionReason.what: (தவிர்ப்புக்கான காரணம்) When it declines, whether it declines for the right one of the five reasons rather than merely declining.

forbiddenClaims.name: தடைசெய்யப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்கள்
forbiddenClaims.what: (தடைசெய்யப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்கள்) Whether answers avoid the phrases each case forbids — novelty conclusions, outcome predictions, dosage.

languageDetection.name: மொழி கண்டறிதல்
languageDetection.what: (மொழி கண்டறிதல்) Whether the script a question is written in is identified. Devanagari cannot separate Hindi from Marathi, so either counts for either and the interface reports the ambiguity.

recordsOffered.name: வழங்கப்பட்ட பதிவுகள்
recordsOffered.what: (வழங்கப்பட்ட பதிவுகள்) Whether filed or granted records appear beside an answer when the question is about the kind of thing that gets filed.

recordsDoNotRescue.name: பதிவுகள் காப்பாற்றாது
recordsDoNotRescue.what: (பதிவுகள் காப்பாற்றாது) Where a record exists and the sources do not support an answer, whether the system still declines.

errors.name: பிழைகள்
errors.what: (பிழைகள்) Cases that raised rather than answering or declining.

evaluation.caveatTitle: What these numbers were measured against
